The policy excerpts provide instructions: go to Settings → Billing → Recipients, add/replace email, multiple recipients can be added. function.arguments: {"message":"Sure! To change the invoice email address, go to **Settings → Billing → Recipients** in your workspace. arguments.message: Sure! To change the invoice email address, go to **Settings → Billing → Recipients** in your workspace. From there you can add a new billing contact email or replace the existing one. You can also add multiple recipients (e.g., a shared finance inbox) alongside an individual address. The change takes effect for the next invoice generated after you save it; past invoices won’t be resent to the new address.
